### Focus Derivation Map

The desktop active terminal context is derived as follows:

```
Focused Group (`state.layout.focusedGroupId` -> `tabGroups[focusedGroupId]`)
    │
    ▼
Active Tab (`focusedGroup.activeTabId ?? state.layout.activeTabId ?? tabs[0].id`)
    │
    ├── Kind is "browser" ──> Clear active terminal (`null`)
    └── Kind is terminal tab:
            │
            ▼
        Active Leaf (`layoutsByTabId[tab.id].activeLeafId ?? collectLeafIds(root)[0]`)
            │
            ▼
        Leaf Local Session (`layoutsByTabId[tab.id].sessionIdsByLeafId[leafId] ?? tab.sessionId`)
            │
            ▼
        Terminal Session (`state.sessions[localSessionId]`)
            │
            ▼
        Backend Session ID (`session.backendSessionId`)
            │
            ▼
        Safe DTO Payload (No absolute filesystem paths published):
        {
          workspaceId: activeProject.workspaceId,
          worktreeSlug: worktreeIdentity(foundWorktree)?.slug ?? worktree.branch,
          worktreeLabel: worktree.branch ?? tab.label,
          backendSessionId: session.backendSessionId
        }
```

### 3. Why All Runtime Focus Publications Now Reach Native

In `src-tauri/src/ipc/remote.rs`, the Tauri IPC command is defined as:
```rust
#[tauri::command]
pub async fn cmd_remote_set_active_selection(
    manager: State<'_, Arc<RemoteGatewayManager>>,
    request: SetActiveDesktopSelectionRequest,
) -> Result<(), IpcError>
```

Tauri's deserializer specifically looks for the top-level parameter named `request`. When invoked with `{ payload: ... }`, `request` was omitted, causing deserialization to fail or receive an empty request.

Updating `ui/src/lib/tauri.ts` to:
```ts
export async function publishFocusedTerminal(payload: FocusedTerminalPayload | null): Promise<void> {
  if (!isTauri()) return;
  return invokeCommand<void>("cmd_remote_set_active_selection", {
    request: {
      workspaceId: payload?.workspaceId ?? null,
      worktreeSlug: payload?.worktreeSlug ?? null,
      worktreeLabel: payload?.worktreeLabel ?? null,
      sessionId: payload?.backendSessionId ?? null,
    },
  }).catch(() => undefined);
}
```
ensures the payload correctly deserializes into `SetActiveDesktopSelectionRequest`, populating `workspace_id`, `worktree_slug`, `worktree_label`, and `session_id` on `RemoteGatewayState.active_selection`.
